title: pack_manifest/v1
description: Manifest of one scenario pack (IC-1). The only pack file committed to the repo (DATA-5): series files are built locally from pinned upstream archives and verified against the hashes recorded here. Packs are versioned by content hash, not counters. Everything here is operator/bundle-side; none of it (pack_id, regime_description, venue, real dates) is ever serialized into an observation (ISO-3/ISO-4).

schema.description: Schema name and major version of this document.

pack_id.description: Human-readable pack slug, e.g. 'covid-2020'. Operator-side only; never shown to the agent.

content_hash.description: The pack's version identity: SHA-256 over the JCS bytes of {"schema":"pack_content/v1","files":[{path,sha256,bytes,records}...]} with entries sorted by path. Referenced by bundle manifests and chain genesis; replay refuses a pack whose recomputed content hash differs (DET-6).

venue.description: Venue identifier, 'binance-um' in V1. Deliberately a string, not an enum: venues (later: merchants, payment rails) are data (commerce-extensibility hook).

window.description: The pack's real-time window. Real UTC epoch-ms here; observations are rebased (see observation/v1).

start_ts.description: First bar open, UTC epoch-milliseconds. Also anchors the observation time-rebase offset: offset = largest whole multiple of 604800000 (one week) <= start_ts, recorded in bundle_manifest.time_rebase_offset_ms.

items.description: Bar duration in milliseconds; V1 ships 1h and/or 4h, nothing shorter.

bar_intervals_ms.description: All bar durations present as series files in this pack.

decision_bar_ms.description: Bar duration the episode loop steps on: 14400000 (4h, default packs) or 3600000 (1h, stress packs). One decision turn per bar of this size.

warmup_bars.description: Decision bars at window start reserved as lookback context before turn 0; no decisions occur during warmup. Explicit so 'how much history did turn 0 legitimately see' is a stored fact, not an inference.

markets.description: Map: agent-facing market alias (e.g. 'BTC') -> full per-market venue descriptor. The alias keeps LLM payloads small and venue identity out of observations (ISO-3); the descriptor binds it to a venue-qualified instrument. Multi-asset shaped from day one (Scope section 2); V1 packs carry exactly one entry.

files.description: Every series file the pack builder must produce, with role, row schema, expected hash, and upstream provenance. The build-twice byte-identity oracle (DET-5).

role.description: Which of the three never-conflated price series (or funding) this file is: index prices funding notional, mark drives margin/liquidation/uPnL, trade drives fills (Protocol section 1).

market.description: Market alias (a key of .markets) this series belongs to.

interval_ms.description: Bar interval in milliseconds; 0 for funding (event-stamped, not bar-shaped).

row_schema.description: Row schema for every line of this JSONL file, e.g. 'bar_row/v1' or 'funding_row/v1'. Declared here once because bulk rows omit per-row schema fields.

sha256.description: SHA-256 over the complete uncompressed file bytes as built.

bytes.description: Uncompressed file size in bytes; lets a verifier detect truncation before hashing.

upstream.description: Source archives this file was derived from, with Binance-published checksums (DATA-1); bulk repo data.binance.vision only (DATA-4).

url.description: Exact upstream archive URL on data.binance.vision.

sha256.description: Upstream .CHECKSUM SHA-256 value, verified before extraction; verification is non-optional.

default_lookback.description: Pack-recommended observation lookback depths. Resolution rule: run_config value wins if set, else this default; whichever is effective is recorded in the bundle (bundle_manifest.run_config).

bars.description: Default number of decision-interval trade bars per observation (V1 default: 64).

funding_prints.description: Default number of trailing settled funding prints per observation (V1 default: 6 = 2 days at 8h).

regime_description.description: One-paragraph human description of the market regime. Bundle/report-side ONLY; never serialized into any observation (ISO-3/ISO-4). Its vocabulary seeds the CI observation-scan denylist.

claim_label.description: Claim class of any result produced from this pack. Constrained single-member enum in V1 so the LABEL-1 CI assertion is a mechanical equality check; 'skill' is not a member by design. Propagates verbatim into metrics.json and every report/share surface.

created_by_version.description: tradeevolve package semver that built this pack (pack-build reproducibility audit, DET-5).

ext.description: Sanctioned extension point (see VERSIONING.md): engine-ignored, hashed as-is. Keys SHOULD be reverse-DNS or x_-prefixed; values are constrained by schema to JCS-safe types with no fractional numbers ($defs/ext_value).

ext_value.description: JCS-safe extension value (DET-2): null, boolean, string, integer within the I-JSON exact range +/-(2^53-1), or arrays/objects of the same, recursively. A JSON number with a fractional part (e.g. 1.5) is schema-INVALID here - ext contents ride into hashed documents as-is, and no fractional number may enter a hashed document. Boundary note: JSON Schema's 'integer' type admits a mathematically-integral literal such as 1.0; the CI instance scan (float-rejecting JSON parse, see VERSIONING.md) closes that remaining lexical gap.

anyOf.description: JSON string (decimal values ride as strings, e.g. '0.7').
Integer within the I-JSON exact range (JCS round-trips it byte-identically).
Object whose values are all JCS-safe.

market_descriptor.description: Full venue parameters for one market. Extensibility scope, stated precisely: the CONTAINER pattern (opaque agent-facing alias -> operator-side registry entry) generalizes to other registries (merchants, products, payment rails); the DESCRIPTOR CONTENTS below are perpetual-futures microstructure (margin tiers, funding, fees, execution model) and are required as such - a non-trading vertical (commerce) ships its own descriptor under a new major, reusing the container and `venue` string. ext can ADD fields but cannot remove the required trade blocks.

instrument.description: Venue-qualified instrument id, e.g. 'binance-um:BTCUSDT'. The authoritative identity behind the agent-facing alias; bundle/audit-side only.

base_asset.description: Base asset code; all *_base_1e8 quantities are 1e-8 units of this.

quote_asset.description: Quote/settlement asset all *_micro amounts are denominated in. USDT for V1 (venue-accurate Binance USDT-M; not the protocol doc's USDC). Const in v1; future quote assets are a minor enum extension.

tick_size_micro.description: One price tick in micro-quote units (BTCUSDT: 100000 = 0.10 USDT). Interprets every *_ticks field for this market.

qty_step_base_1e8.description: Order quantity granularity in 1e-8 base units; fill quantities round toward zero to this step (orders rounding to zero cancel with reason qty_rounding).

min_notional_micro.description: Minimum order notional in micro-quote; smaller orders cancel with reason min_notional.

leverage_cap_lev_1e4.description: Per-market leverage cap in 1e-4 units (BTC: 30000 = 3x; a future SOL entry: 20000 = 2x). Enforced as a recorded RiskCheck gate, never as parse validation.

tiers.description: Margin tier table, ascending by notional cap, as explicit stored integers so replay never derives rates from formulas with rounding ambiguity. Pack validator asserts: at the max-leverage tier, maintenance = half initial.

notional_cap_micro.description: Upper position-notional bound of this tier in micro-quote; the last tier uses 9007199254740991 (unbounded).

initial_rate_1e8.description: Initial margin rate in 1e-8 units (3x cap tier: 33333334 = ceil(1e8/3), conservative).

maintenance_rate_1e8.description: Maintenance margin rate in 1e-8 units; = half the initial rate at the max-leverage tier (data invariant, validator-asserted).

liquidation_penalty_1e8.description: Liquidation penalty rate in 1e-8 of liquidated position notional, charged on top of the conservative-side close (MATH-3).

funding.description: Funding parameters. A per-MARKET data block, never a venue constant (MATH-4; Binance runs 4h/1h intervals on some alts).

interval_ms.description: Funding interval in milliseconds. V1 BTCUSDT: 28800000 (8h).

items.description: One settlement time as a millisecond offset from UTC midnight.

settlement_offsets_ms.description: Settlement times as ms offsets from UTC midnight, e.g. [0, 28800000, 57600000] = 00/08/16 UTC. Integer math, no cron parser, era-exact.

cap_1e8.description: Era-accurate maximum funding rate in 1e-8 units (2020-era Binance: 300000 = +0.30%).

floor_1e8.description: Era-accurate minimum funding rate in 1e-8 units (2020-era: -300000; the COVID 2020-03-13 08:00 print sits exactly here).

maker_rate_1e8.description: Maker fee rate in 1e-8 of notional. Recorded for completeness; V1 charges taker on every fill (Protocol section 1).

taker_rate_1e8.description: Taker fee rate in 1e-8 of notional, applied to every fill, rounded up (agent-adverse rounding).

execution.description: Conservative fill-model parameters, recorded in the pack so replay needs no external calibration input.

half_spread_1e8.description: Worst-side half-spread as a 1e-8 fraction of price, calibrated on evolution-period data only (calibration window documented in calibration_note, never observable by the agent).

impact_model.description: Price-impact functional form; exact integer arithmetic and per-operation rounding pinned by spec/fill-model.md and the golden fixture (C0.3).

impact_coeff_1e8.description: Impact coefficient in 1e-8 units, applied to the participation ratio under impact_model.

participation_cap_1e8.description: Maximum fraction of the fill bar's trade volume an order may take, in 1e-8 units. Excess quantity is CANCELLED, never filled (MATH-7).

cost_profile_multipliers_1e4.description: Cost profile name -> multiplier applied to all execution costs (spread, fee, impact) in 1e-4 units. V1: {"primary": 10000, "stress_2x": 20000}. Profiles are pack data so the 2x re-simulation is fully determined by the pack (MATH-5).

calibration_note.description: Optional human documentation of how half_spread/impact were calibrated (window, method). Audit-side only.

ext.description: Sanctioned extension point (see VERSIONING.md). Engine-ignored, hashed as-is; values are constrained by schema to JCS-safe types with no fractional numbers ($defs/ext_value).
